lexical_contract.grammar_description: SIGN? YEN H* 円 H* SEN H* 銭; H is ASCII space, tab or U+3000 only. No leading/trailing whitespace. SIGN is exactly one of +,-,△,▲ at display start. YEN is ASCII integer, either ungrouped digits or1–3initial digits followed by comma groups of exactly3digits. SEN is1or2ASCII digits, integer0..99.
lexical_contract.leading_zeros: Allowed as current ungrouped integer token; raw spelling preserved. No interpretation as octal.
lexical_contract.horizontal_only: Reject CR/LF/formfeed, vertical tab, NEL, Unicode line/paragraph separators and NBSP; do not use unrestricted\s or normalize whitespace.
lexical_contract.sign_binding: Sign applies to complete yen+sen sum, including -0円05銭 -> -0.05; no sign on sen, no second sign, no parentheses or Unicode-minus normalization.
lexical_contract.source_presence: Exact raw display must occur in exact basis_quote before any comma/sign processing. Use boundary checks for the whole display so no prefix/suffix numeric token can be stripped; source position still does not certify a table cell.
lexical_contract.boundary_policy: At minimum preserve existing ASCII numeric/token-neighbor refusal; for this new format also refuse immediately adjacent Unicode decimal digits or alternative sign characters that would let a malformed larger display be sliced into a valid positive display. No legacy parser change.
lexical_contract.missing: None, empty or horizontal-space-only strings retain null and missing/empty status, both verification flags false. Existing stand-alone dash markers retain null/unconfirmed_dash after existing whole-token quote check; never zero. Non-horizontal whitespace-only strings rejected in this opt-in format. A null output must not label1904 printed amounts as missing.

decimal_composition.context: Reuse explicit local Decimal context and trap policy; size precision for yen digits plus cents/carry guard (at least existing80digits). Include conversion, multiplication, addition and formatting within protected arithmetic; do not depend on ambient precision/traps or use float.
decimal_composition.rendering: Output value remains a decimal string. For nonzero new-format values retain2decimal places through exact sen*0.01 arithmetic; zero including negative zero canonicalizes to"0". Do not round cents, carry100sen or quantize to hide malformed input.
